test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: What did the school inspire villagers to do?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains that the school’s use of solar panels not only benefited itself but also motivated nearby villagers.
 
• It clearly states that the school **inspired nearby houses to install solar panels**.
 
• This shows the impact of one institution’s initiative spreading to the community.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Install solar panels**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Use less water** – Not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Option 2: Buy new uniforms** – Irrelevant to the context of clean energy.
 
• **Option 4: Visit the school more** – No such detail is provided in the passage.
